title: Logic Remote message batch, as decoded from a frame
description: What a frame carries once the tag, the MAZP container and the property list / JSON / keyed archive layer are removed (SA-REMOTE-FRAME-001, static analysis; not checked against real traffic). A dictionary maps an address to its argument. An array is an ordered batch of such dictionaries (sent only to peers with protocol version 7 or later). Dictionary key order is not defined. A keyed archive (format 2) may also use number keys and carry NSData, NSURL and NSIndexPath values, which JSON cannot express; for those, use the Swift RemoteValue model.

messages.description: address -> argument. Addresses seen in Logic start with '/'.

argument.description: Any JSON value. A message without an argument carries a placeholder number whose value is not yet known.
